name: 4D Tetrahedron Slicing (Vertex Shader)
definition: A GPU-based method to compute the 3D cross-section of a 4D tetrahedron against a slicing hyperplane using the Vertex Shader. It outputs 0, 1, or 2 triangles representing the intersection.
summary: A GPU method computing 3D tetrahedron cross-sections via vertex replication and parallel processing, avoiding adjacency primitives and data replication at the cost of increased branching.
